//: Shared libraries a sim artefact may load, served same-origin at /vendor/<lib>/<version>/<file>. Admission policy: .claude/skills/mcp-app-artefact/resources/vendored-libraries.md. Every file comes from a pinned npm dependency in package.json (so npm audit + dependabot see it), is hash-checked at server start (a mismatch refuses to serve), and must be referenced with the same sha384 as an SRI integrity attribute (audit_artefact.sh enforces it).

three.why: WebGL 3D scenes (sol-jord-maane). r128 is the last release line whose build/three.min.js exposes the global THREE the sim is written against; it is byte-identical to cdnjs three.js/r128.

anatomy-kit.why: Crafted isometric apparatus figures (the anatomy kit's drawing half + its CSS) for generated sims. Not on npm: generated from the vendored, pinned skill by scripts/build-anatomy-kit-vendor.mjs (exception recorded in vendored-libraries.md).

uplot.why: Live x-y plots (x-t, v-t, p-V, energy) for generated sims: axes, ticks and scaling are where generated canvas graphs most often go wrong. ~50 KB, exposes the global uPlot. Its 1.8 KB stylesheet is inlined by the sim (guide: backend/sim_authoring/references/plots.md), not served.

matter-js.why: 2D rigid-body contact (billiards, stacking, ramps with friction, chains) that is hard to hand-write. Approximate impulse solver: a sim that shows measured momentum or energy states its tolerance, and 1D collisions use aipla-physics' exact formula instead. ~83 KB, exposes the global Matter.

aipla-physics.why: AIPLA's own small helpers (fixed-step loop, RK4/Verlet, exact 1D and disc collisions, seeded measurement noise, instrument resolution, Danish number format). Not on npm: written here, tested in __tests__/aipla-physics.test.ts (exception recorded in vendored-libraries.md). ~9 KB, exposes window.AIPLA_PHYSICS.
